how_to_apply: Thane Kotwal Apply Online is available only through the official website. Only applications filled in the prescribed online format on the website, along with the exam fee paid through the prescribed challan, will be accepted. Applications received in any other way will not be accepted.
Read the detailed advertisement for the Mahsul Sevak (Kotwal) recruitment carefully.
Fill in the online application form in the prescribed format.
Pay the examination fee online through the prescribed challan.
Submit the application on or before 21 October 2026, 5:00 PM.
Candidates are responsible for visiting the website from time to time to stay updated on the recruitment process.
important_instructions: The Selection Committee Chairman and the Sub-Divisional Officer, Ulhasnagar have the right to postpone or cancel the recruitment process or exam, make partial changes, and increase or decrease the total number of posts and category-wise posts. content_sections.heading: Thane Kotwal Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: The notification lists vacancies separately for each taluka. Some talukas have separate lists for PESA areas (grouped by percentage of tribal population) and non-PESA areas. The vacancies are to be filled under social and women reservation, with 30% of posts shown for women in each list. Taluka-wise totals: Thane 24, Bhiwandi 14, Kalyan 14, Ambernath 21, Murbad 19 and Shahapur 19. The overall total of 111 and the General/Women column totals have been added up from the taluka-wise tables, as the notice does not state a single grand total. The notification uses Marathi abbreviations for the categories. English equivalents are given in brackets for easy reading. The percentages are as printed in the notification; the PESA lists for 25% to 50% and above 50% areas show a 50% reservation for अ.ज. (ST) and for अराखीव (Open). Candidates should check the original notification for the exact reservation percentages of each category before applying.

content_sections.heading: Thane Kotwal Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: The notification gives a tentative schedule (संभाव्य वेळापत्रक). The Thane Kotwal last date to apply online and to pay the examination fee online is 21 October 2026 up to 5:00 PM. The exam is scheduled for Sunday, 15 November 2026; the exam time is not specified in the provided notification.

content_sections.heading: Thane Kotwal Application Fee
content_sections.text: The notification mentions an examination fee that must be paid online through the prescribed challan, with 21 October 2026 (5:00 PM) as the last date for payment. The fee amount and category-wise fee details are not specified in the provided notification.

content_sections.heading: Thane Kotwal Selection Process
content_sections.text: The notification does not describe the selection stages in detail. Based on the tentative schedule, the recruitment process includes the following stages: Scrutiny of applications (22 October 2026 to 01 November 2026) Exam on 15 November 2026 Answer key and result announcement on 16 November 2026 Document verification (17 November 2026 to 27 November 2026) Appointment letter on 28 November 2026 The exam pattern, syllabus, marking scheme and exam centres are not specified in the provided notification.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Thane Kotwal Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Thane Kotwal Apply Online is available only through the official website. Only applications filled in the prescribed online format on the website, along with the exam fee paid through the prescribed challan, will be accepted. Applications received in any other way will not be accepted. Candidates are responsible for visiting the website from time to time to stay updated on the recruitment process.

content_sections.heading: Important Notes from the Notification
content_sections.text: The Selection Committee Chairman and the Sub-Divisional Officer, Ulhasnagar have the right to postpone or cancel the recruitment process or exam, make partial changes, and increase or decrease the total number of posts and category-wise posts. The same authority has the final decision on any dispute or complaint related to the recruitment process. The notification states that the total number of posts and the reservation may change.
